# Pier & Point

> The cited record of development on San Francisco's central waterfront: what is built, under way and next on four sites (Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70, Potrero Power Station), parcel by parcel, with a source for every claim and every correction kept visible.

Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

Two levels of confidence: "parcel" records sit on a real DataSF Assessor parcel; "approximate" records are traced from adopted planning figures and carry their own accuracy note. Nothing is fabricated: a missing date or status means no source supports one. Pier & Point takes no money from any developer, landowner or agency whose sites it covers.

Record as of 2026-09-22. Terms: https://pierandpoint.org/terms/

## Machine-readable data (static JSON, no key)

- [All records](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/records.json): every record with facts, costs, milestones, images, sources, open questions and GeoJSON geometry
- [One record](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/records/<slug>.json): the same, one file per record; the slug is the permalink's last segment
- [Sites](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/sites.json): the four sites and their records
- [Milestones](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/milestones.json): every dated event, sourced, with expected dates flagged
- [Changes](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/changes.json): every addition and correction Pier & Point made to its own record
- [Retail](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/retail.json): confirmed ground-floor tenants, tied to their parcel
- [Snapshot](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/snapshot.json): build date, git commit and SHA-256 of records.json and llms.txt, attested independently at https://github.com/pierandpoint/record
- [RSS feed](https://pierandpoint.org/api/v1/feed.xml): changes and milestones, newest first
- [Public data repository](https://github.com/pierandpoint/record): every file above, plus the schema and how to verify a publish's signature

## Sites

- [Mission Rock](https://pierandpoint.org/sites/mission-rock/): Pier 50 · Giants and Tishman Speyer; 21 records
- [Mission Bay](https://pierandpoint.org/sites/mission-bay/): OCII redevelopment area; 104 records
- [Pier 70](https://pierandpoint.org/sites/pier-70/): 28-acre site · Brookfield Properties; 29 records
- [Potrero Power Station](https://pierandpoint.org/sites/potrero/): Former PG&E plant · Associate Capital; 23 records
